༄༅/ /gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi lo rgyus mu tig phreng ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi lo rgyus mu tig phreng ba bzhugs/

'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du theg pa chen po'i gcod kyi dbang zab mo gsan snyams pa'i bsam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed te gsan par zhu/ gang gsan par byed pa de nyid la yang*/ rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor las/ lo rgyus don gyis ma bshad na/ /gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la/ /yid mi ches pa'i skyon du gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ sngon gyi dus na/ ngam shod smad kyi grogs mtsho bya ba na/ yab sge khad chos la bya ba dang*/ yum phyug mo 'bum sde lcam bya ba'i lhums su zhugs nas/ ma'i lus la bzhugs pa'i skabs su yum gyi rmi lam du sgron me btegs pa dang*/ zla ba drug lon pa'i dus su khyim thams cad sgron mes gang ba dang*/ zla ba dgu pa'i dus su yul thams cad sgron mes gang ba rmis pa dang*/ zla ba bcu lon pa'i skabs su ga ta'i sngags dang ha ri ni sa'i sngags sgra grags pa sogs ngo mtshar ba mang du 'byung bas yum gyis yab la/ nga'i lus la yod pa 'di lha mi gang gis sprul pa yin pa mi shes/ 'di 'dra'i rtags byung ba ci yin dris pa na/ yab kyis ga ti'i sngags ni bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po dang*/ ha ri ni sa mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi snying po yin/ bdud kyis sprul pa ni min gzhan la ma smra gsungs/ de nas sku bltams te mas gzigs pa na/ mdog dkar ba dpral ba na spyan gsum yod pa zhal nas a a zhes gsungs pa/ skye thog tu yi ge hrīḥdamar po gcig 'khor ba snang ba'i yab la smras pa na/ yab kyis 'di bzang ngan ci yin shan ma 'byed kyi bar du gsang dgos gsungs/ zla ba gsum lon pa na mi rnams kyis yid du 'ong ba dang ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ma du ma byung ba dang*/ de nas yab yum dag gis sgron tshe ma zhes ming btags*/ yul du nad rims yod pa rnams kyi rgyun chad pa dang*/ de nas dge bshes in ston gyi mdun du phyin nas de'i zhal nas khyod kyi bu mo 'di la mkha' 'gro ma'i mtshan rtags tshang 'dug 'di la klog slob dang chos pa bzang po zhig 'ong bar 'dug gsungs/

de nas rab tu byung nas yi ge bslab pas lo bcu tsam nas klog la mkhas par gyur/ dus lan gcig na yul de'i rgyal pos ston mo chen po bshams pas thams cad ston mo la song ba'i der 'dus pa'i pho mo thams cad kyis bu mo 'di gang nas 'ong ba yin 'di ngo mtshar ba gcig 'dug ces kun gyis smras pa dang*/ yab kyis lab kyi yul nas 'ong ba yin pa sogs rgyu mtshan bshad pa dang*/ khrom rnams kyis bu mo la lab sgron mtshan du gsol ba yin/ de nas g.yu ru gra thang du byon nas/ grwa pa mngon shes can gyi drung du 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'don nas 'dug tsa na/ rgya pho ba grong 'jug gi 'bum cha gcig klog pa'i grwa pa mngon shes can gyis jo mo khyod zhwa chung 'di gyon na bzang bar 'dug gsungs pa'i ming jo mo zhwa chung can du btags/ rgya pho ba grong 'jug gi klog 'don pa las jo mo nyis 'gyur gyis bzang po thag chod pa byung*/ de skabs rgya gar gyi a tsa ra'i mngon shes kyi gzigs nas der byon pa'i sngon rgya gar ser skya'i grong khyer du byon pa'i paṇḍi ta a tsa ra gcig po ṭa la'i brag phug tu bsgoms nas yod pa'i dus su mkha' 'gros lung bstan nas sngon las mkhan byas pa 'dir tshe 'phos nas/ lab kyi lung pa na sku 'khrungs te/ 'dir bzhugs pa mjal du 'ong ba yin zer/ phyir nyin nyi ma shar dus mjal ba'i phyag byas nas dbu gtugs res byas/ jo mo'i zhal nas/ dam pa khyod bod yul du 'gro don la byon pa ngo mtshar che gsungs/ dam pa'i zhal nas khyod ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma bod yul du 'gro don du byon pa yin pas ngo mtshar che/ a tsa ra de nyid dam pa rgya gar yin/ jo mo ni ma cig lab kyi sgron ma yum chen mo'i sprul pa bod yul du 'gro don la pheb pa dang*/ 'di'i chos rgyun ni mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ltar mtha' dbus med par sa steng kun tu khyab pa yin/ de nas dbu gtsang dang rgyal khams phyogs med du byon pa dang*/

la stod dwang ri la byon nas dam pa rgya gar dang mjal/ dam pa'i mngon shes kyis gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma lab kyi sgron ma byon gsungs pas thams cad kyis bsu ba byas/ dam pa dang nyams bskur byas/ de nas zangs ri mkhar dmar du byon te/ yon bdag mo chos mtsho bya ba gcig gi rtsar bzhugs nas yod skabs srod la gzhi bdag de byung nas des jo mo khyod kyi mtshan ni lab sgron du snang*/ steng ya ki na dur khrod yod pa de la dgon pa btabs nas bzhugs na ngas yon bdag byed zer/ yang mi dmar rta dmar can zhig 'byung ba 'di zangs ri'i gzhi bdag yin par snang*/ der dgon pa btabs nas bzhugs pa'i lo gsum tsam na bstan pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ sku'i snyan pa 'brug ltar sgrogs pa byung*/ de nas rgya chos dang bod chos gnam chos sa chos sogs dang*/ bka' gter gnyis dang pho gcod mo gcod sogs ngos bzung byas/ chos 'di'i brgyud pa bshad na spyir dam pa'i chos thams cad rgya gar nas bod la dar ba yin/ bod kyi chos rgya gar na'ang yod/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan du chos thams cad bsdus nas chos thams cad rgya gar na'ang yod pa yin gyi/ deng sang bod la phyag rgya chen po'i gcod pa gcig yod zer bas ci 'dra yin rkang mgyogs gcig byas nas rgya gar la 'gro zer nas gros byas nas rkang mgyogs btang*/ khra hor ba dgung sngon la 'grim pa bzhin byon pas zhag gnyis nas zangs ri mkhar dmar ma'i sgo drung du slebs/ de nas nye gnas rnams kyis 'u cag gi sgo drung na a tsa ra gsum 'dug zer/ ma'i zhal nas a tsa ra gsum gyi gzugs ci 'dra/ gos ci 'dra gyon 'dug ltos gsungs nas bltas tsa na/ gzhan gyis gos gyon lugs ma red/ dar gyi la wos gsum de gyon 'dug zer/ de nas mas mdun du bos nas 'tsho ba drangs*/ bgro gleng byas tsa na/ mas rgya gar gyi skad thogs med du mkhyen/ a tsa ra rnams kyis nyid kyi rgya gar gyi skad 'di tsam mkhyen pa 'di ci yin dris pas/

ma'i zhal nas nga tshe snga ma rgya gar du skyes pas yin gsungs/ a tsa ras skye ba dran pa yin nam zer bas/ ngas skye ba snga phyi da lta gsum dran gsungs/ de gsum ci ltar dran gsungs zhus pa'i/ ma'i rgya gar skad kyis bshad na grwa slob rnams kyi mi go /bshad kyang dgos pa chung gsungs/ de nas a tsa ra gsum brang khang du bzhag pa'i zhabs tog byas/ dbu gtsang ru bzhi'i mkhas btsun rnams dang*/ yul phyogs kyi grwa skor yon bdag dang*/ rgya gar ba dang bod kyi lo tsā ba kun la/ pho nya btang nas thams cad bsdus pas 'bum tsho bdun dang brgya 'tshogs te/ de nas mchod pa chen po dang ston mo bshams/ der 'tshogs pa rnams kyi gong du bzhugs nas ma cig gi mdun du a tsa ra rnams bos nas chos kyi bgro gleng byas te log rtog ci rigs pa bsal/ dbu gtsang gi lo tsā ba bzhis 'tshogs pa rnams la lo tsās bsgyur nas ma'i chos rgyud thams cad kun gyis yid ches pa dang*/ a tsa ra rnams kyis chos thams cad rgya gar nas ma byung ba med gsungs/ ma'i zhal nas rgya gar bod la bka' drin che/ rgya gar nas chos dar tshul khyed gsum gyis shod gsungs/ nged gsum gyis mi shes pas mas gsungs zhus pas/ ma'i zhal nas nga ni yum chen mo'i sprul pa yin pas shes zer/ sngon rgya gar gyi rgyal po dza wa bya ba bzhugs pa'i dus su gdamags ngag gi rgyun thams cad char bzhin du babs pa yin/ de yang yum gyis byin gyis rlabs pa yin gsungs/ 'o skol 'dir 'tshogs pa'i khrom pa rnams gson dang*/ nga yi skye ba snga phyi da lta rnams ma bshad na nga yi brgyud pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis yid mi ches/ phyag rgya chen po'i gcod kyi rgyud ma bshad na gdams ngag la yid mi ches gsungs nas skye ba snga phyi dang gcod kyi rgyun zla ba gcig la gsungs pas/ der 'tshogs pa rnams kyis yid ches/ tshig gi sgro 'dog chod pa dang*/ yang yum gyi skye rabs ni/

sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ldan lha yul na/ gling chen po bde skyob nor bu phun tshogs kyi gling zhes bya ba na/ yab ni rgyal po bde skyong dang*/ yum dpal mtsho bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs te lha yul du 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ de nas rdo rje gdan gyi ser skya'i grong khyer du yab a'i dbang phyug /yum lha za klu sgron bya ba gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ mtshan sde smon 'grub tu btags/ rgya gar gyi mu stegs pa mang po btul nas nang pa'i sde la bkod/ yab yum kyi gshegs rdzong byas/ chos tshan gyi sgro 'dogs bcad nas po ta la'i brag phug tu sgom zhing bzhugs pa'i skabs su mkha' 'gro las mkhan byas nas bem rig bral/ ngas bem po brag phug nang du yod pa'i mgo la rgyal ba rig lnga la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma lngas bskor ba 'bur du dod pa dang*/ snying la shākya thub pa rang byung du dod pa yod pa dang*/ lhag ma'i ro de la gdung sha ri raṃ sran ma tsam 'bum dang*/ de ma yin pa'i ring bsrel kha dog sna lnga pa rdo rje gdan gyi bre gang gi tshad byon nas yod/ zhes gsungs pas der 'tshogs pa rnams kyis gros byas nas rgya gar du rkang mgyogs gsum btang nas/ rdo rje gdan du song nas rgya gar gyi rgyal po dang paṇḍi ta rnams 'dus nas thams cad la sngar gyi ma'i lo rgyus dang*/ po ta la'i ri'i khung gi gdungs rus kyi lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ rgyal po dang paṇḍi ta rnams kyi zhal nas 'di yum gyi sprul pa yin nam rgyal bsen gyi sprul ba yin cha med/ gdams ngag ma lus pa len dgos/ po ta la'i brag phug tu song nas i bden ltos gsungs te/ panṭi ta rnams der song bas/ lab sgron gyi ci skad gsungs pa bzhin yod pas gdung rus rnams rgya gar du gdan drangs/ rgyal po rnams kyis phyogs su rkang mgyog btang te mi skya pho mo rnams bsdus nas/ rten rnams bstan pas kun gyis ngo mtshar skyes nas/

ma cig gi chos rgyun gcod rgyud rnams gdan drangs pa'i gros byas*/ ring bsrel bre gang yod pa de rgyal po thams cad la phul bas tshim par byas/ dbu la rigs lnga bzhugs pa rdo rje gdan du bzhag te rten du byas/ thugs la shākya thub pa yod pa de bod yul du dam pa rgya gar dang rkang mgyogs gi mi rnams kyis bzung nas zangs ri mkhar dmar du ma'i drung du 'ongs nas/ khyaid yum chen thugs sprul yin pas ngo mtshar che/ zhal nas gsungs pa thams cad 'khrul med du 'dug pa sogs zhus pa dang*/ de nas thugs la byon pa'i shākya thub pa de dbus gtsang gi skye bo thams cad la mjal bcug nas kun kyi rgyud la lung rtogs kyi bstan pa ci rigs pa skyes pa'i sgo nas 'gro don rgya cher 'byung*/ thugs su gyur pa'i rten de dam pa rgya gar gyi gdan drangs/ de nas ma cig gis gcod kyi rgyud pha rgyud ma rgyud nye rgyud ring rgyud thams cad gsungs nas bsdus te ngo mtshar can gyi brjod pa bcu gsum gsungs pa dang*/ de thams cad rkang mgyogs gsum la rdo rje gdan du bskur nas rgya gar du dar bar mdzad/ de nas yum gyi sras 'grub pa/ 'grub chung*/ thod snyon bsam 'grub bya ba de rnams yin pa'i 'grub chung ni/ lo bcu lon pa na gza' nad phog nas : bsnyo [ smyo ] brgyal du song ba ni/ ma'i drung du khyer ba'i mas snod ldan du gzigs pa dang*/ rmi lam du phyogs bzhir dung 'bud pas gling bzhi la sgras khyab par rmis/ de nas mas rjes su bzung nas dmigs pa brgya rtsa bstan dur khrod na zhag bdun nyal bas smyo nad kyang sos/ dam pa rgya gar gyi mdun du rab tu byung*/ mtshan thod snyan bsam 'grub gsol/ ma'i thugs la yod pa'i gdams pa rnams gnang*/ ma cig seng ge dkar mo la chibs te sham bu gangs la byon nas sedge'i khri'i steng nas mkha' 'gro mas tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'i skabs su sras kyang der byon nas rgyud pa'i dbang dang*/

tshe dbang ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i dbang*/ snyan rgyud kyi lung bstan thams cad bgrol nas gnang/ sham bu'i gzhi bdag yang dam la btags nas bka' sgo mdzad/ de nas ma'i zhal nas nga lo dgu bcu go dgu lon pas/ sras rgyal ba don 'grub la dbusu gtsang ru bzhi'i grwa slob rnams bsdus gsungs/ thams cad bsdus nas tshogs brgya mang du byas/ dbang dang byin rlabs mdzad/ dam rdzas rnams grwa pa rnams la gnang*/ 'brug gi lo'i tshes bco lnga'i mtshan mor zangs mkhar du byon nas tho rangs skya rings shar ba'i dus su sku gshegs tshul byas/ skabs su sras gnyis kyi phyag tu zhal mchil re re blugs pas/ sras rgyal ba don 'grub kyi phyag tu dung g.yas su 'khyil ba gcig byon/ 'gro ba'i don yun ring du 'byung bar gyur cig gsungs/ thod snya ོ na bsam 'grub kyi phyag tu rje btsun ma'i sku gcig byon/ mo rgyud dbang dang ldan par gyur cig ces gsungs/ de nas ma cig seng ge la chibs nas 'khor mkha' 'gro ma grangs med kyis bskor nas sku lus lhag med du nub phyogs u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i yul du phebs/ de nas sras thod snyon bsam 'grub sham bu'i gad la pheb nas/ sras gnyis dang grwa slob rnams kyis ma'i na bza' rnams me mchod byas pas 'ga' zhig rten rnams bzhengs mchod pa rgya chen po byas so/ /de nas sras gnyis dang grwa slob rnams kyis gcod kyi rgyud sa steng kun tu khyab par byas/ ma'i zhal nas gcod 'di g.yu'i dum bu dang gser gyi phye ma dang 'dra/ man ngag sna res kyang phan thogs chen po 'byung*/ de bzhin du gcod mkhan gyi chos gzhan mi shes kyang gcod 'dis 'gro don byed thub/ skye med kyi don khong du chud nas sems can thams cad smin grol gyi lam la myur du 'god pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i sangs rgyas nas da lta'i bar du brgyud pa'i zam pa ma chad/ gdams ngag kyi bcud ma nyams/ byin rlabs kyi drod ma yal/

bka' rgyud don gyi gdams pa dbang po rab 'bring mtha' gsum gyi gcod nang drod tshad gsum dang ldan pa/ cho 'phrul rang zhi la gtong bar byed pa'i nad brgya sman gcig ltar byin brlabs rtags mtshan dang ldan pa ni/ grub thob gcod kyi rgyud 'di nyid yin la/ 'di'i dbang zab mo sgrub bar byed pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba gnyis yod pa las slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du legs par grub zin/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngos skal du gyur pa la bla ma dang ma cig lab sgron dbyer ma mchis pa'i drung du dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ oṃ badzra bhu mi aḥhūṃ/ zhes sogs maṇḍal phul// //zhes gcod dbang gi lo rgyus mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gcod rgyud rnams kyi nang nas nye bar mkho ba rnams karmā bi dza ya <'phrin las rnam rgyal/> sa smras pa'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 342 -- PAGE 341 -- PAGE 334 -
